As a general note, feedback should ideally be sought before a mainlist post. Readers who vote on articles are not obligated to explain their vote; furthermore, if a piece is negatively rated, reviewers may not be keen to post critique if the page and its discussion thread will be deleted.

The How to Write an SCP Guide has instructions on where/how to seek feedback before posting material to the mainlist.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5359 designates a group of buildings in ████, USA. SCP-5359 consists of seven (7) buildings designated SCP-5359-01 through -07. A circular stone clearing with a 30 meter circumference is in the center of the building. Each of these buildings has a different anomalous property as listed below.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5311 Class: Euclid is a 9 year old girl who loves to make paintings. She is 4'3 in height and weighs 153lb. The girl has short black hair and a white dress down to her knees. She has 2 beaded bracelets on her right arm that are also white. Not to mention the fact that she has incredibly bad hearing and will have to resort to reading things off of a piece of paper when communicating with others. She is very sensitive to high pitched sounds. She has no known name and researchers has not found any info about her past yet.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5215 is a two-floor 15m x 10m wooden motel in the Malian part of Sahara Desert near the town of ██████. When a human being makes eye contact with the building, SCP-5215 becomes active. The human subject starts hearing their dead friends’ or relatives’ voices calling them from inside the motel. This attracts the human to enter although it is up to them to do so. There is no way to access the 2nd floor, what lies there is still a mystery. Inside, there are four seats, two doors and a counter. In the left door there is a small room with a chair which has limbless body with no inferior jaw and eyes.

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5485 is a 23 year old white male named [redacted].

Those who have interacted with [redacted] have described it as unremarkable and boring in every way.

Deleted at -20 and three staff votes.

Voices

It started when old Hubard, drunk out his mind on stale mead and the dulled memories of some battle he’d probably run from, locked himself in a shack just outside of Goldweald. Davil tried to break the door in, good neighbor as he was, but the miserable fossil had more strength than anyone could have anticipated, bracing his entire body against the entrance as he babbled about heights and spiders and being pecked to death by birds. No one believed the man was being pecked to death by anything but a bottle, so we all went home, assuming, as one does, that with a day to dry out, the ordeal would sort itself.

Deleted at -12 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Grigori Karpin

+ show block
– hide block

This isn’t badly written but I’m sorta lost as to what it’s about, could be I’m just not familiar with the subject matter… either way I think a little bit of a hint as to a connection to SCP or other aspect of the universe would be helpful (if there is one and this isn’t something totally independent)

Got some formatting issues:

Davil asks again, and it repeats: “I’ll take the old road to Amberfel and call the guard.”

missing a paragraph space after this

But we should have.

missing a paragraph space before this

I’m actually sure there’s more than that (other examples of paragraphs that should be separated, but I’m reading on mobile)

Uncle Nicolini

+ show block
– hide block

I personally don't care if a tale isn't related to an SCP or even an existing anomaly, but I do care about having the story makes sense. This isn't poorly written, like Grigori said, I think its fine in that regard. However, this tale falls apart for me because I can't connect any dots to an overarching story and it feels like events just happen without meaning.

This sign was found at a ██████████ at █████,Florida, it is a 1/4 by 1/2 a meter in size and simply reads HAM BISCUIT. We have not been able to find a reason for its existence but it is impossible to photograph this item due to its sudden disappearance when photographed by conventional means.

– hide block

I don't think there's much to say here. This is a badly written entry with zero substance whatsoever.
I'd recommend reading the tips on how to create a proper SCP entry first and playing around with the sandbox before doing something like this.

/scp-xxxx-class-keter-neutralized-special-containment-procedu (The life sucking SCP) by JSSRocket deleted at -21 and three votes.

SCP-xxxx was a clutter of buildings in Hong Kong measuring approximately 6.4 square acres. SCP-xxxx was discovered by the SCP Foundation when an urban explorer known as 31 year old Seol ██████ went inside SCP-xxxx for approximately 4 hours, and came out aged at approximately 80 years old. Seol died on █/██, 2009 while in Foundation custody. Upon discovery of SCP-xxxx, the Foundation immediately bought out the plot of land containing SCP-xxxx, and a cover story for SCP-xxxx was formulated, describing SCP-xxxx as an ungoverned, dangerous settlement called the Kowloon walled city.
